basicDetails.schemeName: Scheme for Dronacharya Award for Outstanding Coaches in Sports and Games

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: "Scheme for Dronacharya Award for Outstanding Coaches in Sports and Games" has been launched by the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports. The award is conferred upon coaches who have made exceptional contributions to sports coaching and athlete development. **Objectives:** - To honour coaches who have consistently produced outstanding international-level sportspersons. - To motivate coaches to dedicate themselves to improving sports performance standards and bringing glory to India through international achievements. **Sports Disciplines Covered:** The award is given to coaches associated with: - Olympic sports disciplines. - Non-Olympic sports disciplines recognized by the Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports. - Indigenous sports recognized by the Government of India. **Award Categories:** - Dronacharya Award (Regular) - Dronacharya Award (Lifetime Contribution) **Number of Awards:** - Ordinarily, not more than 5 awards are given in a calendar year. - Out of these, 2 awards are reserved for Lifetime Contribution in Coaching.
schemeContent.benefits_md: > **Selected awardees receive:** **Dronacharya Award (Regular)** - Statuette - Certificate - Ceremonial Dress - Cash Prize of ₹10,00,000 **Dronacharya Award (Lifetime Contribution)** - Statuette - Certificate - Ceremonial Dress - Cash Prize of ₹15,00,000 **Additional Information** - The awards are ordinarily conferred by the President of India on 29th August (National Sports Day). - No individual can receive the award more than once. - The award may be conferred posthumously.
schemeContent.exclusions_md: 1. The applicant is a recipient of the Arjuna Award (Lifetime) (earlier known as Dhyan Chand Award). 1. The applicant is involved in canvassing for the award. 1. A coach associated with doping violations becomes eligible only after completion of the prescribed punishment, suspension, or ban period. Achievements during the suspension period will not be considered. If an inquiry is pending, the concerned sportsperson's achievements will not be considered.
schemeContent.briefDescription: The award for Outstanding Coaches in Sports & Games is a prestigious national sports award instituted by the Government of India to recognize coaches who have consistently demonstrated outstanding & meritorious work in training sportspersons to achieve excellence at international competitions.

children.text: "Scheme for Dronacharya Award for Outstanding Coaches in Sports and Games" has been launched by the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports. The award is conferred upon coaches who have made exceptional contributions to sports coaching and athlete development.
To honour coaches who have consistently produced outstanding international-level sportspersons.
To motivate coaches to dedicate themselves to improving sports performance standards and bringing glory to India through international achievements.
The award is given to coaches associated with:
Non-Olympic sports disciplines recognized by the Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports.
Indigenous sports recognized by the Government of India.
Ordinarily, not more than 5 awards are given in a calendar year.
Out of these, 2 awards are reserved for Lifetime Contribution in Coaching.
The awards are ordinarily conferred by the President of India on 29th August (National Sports Day).
No individual can receive the award more than once.
The award may be conferred posthumously.
The applicant is a recipient of the Arjuna Award (Lifetime) (earlier known as Dhyan Chand Award).
The applicant is involved in canvassing for the award.

A coach associated with doping violations becomes eligible only after completion of the prescribed punishment, suspension, or ban period. Achievements during the suspension period will not be considered. If an inquiry is pending, the concerned sportsperson's achievements will not be considered.
Visit the Department of Sports online portal:
Register on the portal by providing the required details and completing mobile OTP verification.
Log in using the credentials received after registration.
Complete and update the applicant profile.
Select the Dronacharya Award scheme and submit the application online.
After successful submission, a unique registration number will be generated for future reference.
Eligible coaches may apply directly through the online portal without requiring recommendations from nominating authorities.
The government may nominate up to two deserving candidates.
The award is granted for the calendar year in which applications are invited.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md: **Eligibility for Regular Dronacharya Award** 1. The applicant must be a coach at the Grassroot, Development, or Elite level. 1. The applicant must have produced outstanding sporting achievements during the four years immediately preceding the award year. 1. Submit details of the athletes coached and the coaching period claimed for the achievements. **Eligibility for Lifetime Contribution Category** 1. The applicant must have contributed to coaching and athlete development for 20 years or more. 1. In the case of Grassroot/Development coaches, they have been associated with an athlete for at least 5 years during the 20-year period.
